itens.titulo: Can You Borrow Against Your Bitcoin Without Selling It? Costs and Risks You Should Know
itens.descricao: Can You Borrow Against Your Bitcoin Without Selling It? Costs and Risks You Should Know Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read - Bitcoin-backed loans let you borrow up to 60% of your holdings at 7.25% interest, but a 14% price drop triggers a margin call.
- Bitcoin's 54% crash from its all-time high would have triggered liquidation halfway through the decline, with each forced sale creating a separate taxable event.
- Dropping your LTV from 60% to 40% doubles your price-drop buffer from 25% to 50%, dramatically reducing the chance of forced liquidation.

According to Himanshu Sahay, co-founder and chief revenue officer at Arch Lending, retail borrowers can secure loans for up to 60% of their Bitcoin's value, with interest rates starting at 7.25% per year.
If you take out a loan at this level, Bitcoin could drop about 25% before Arch steps in and sells any of your collateral.
As of October 9, Bitcoin is trading around $82,581, down 4% over the past week and 32% since last year, about 35% below its all-time high of $126,080.
For example, if you take out a $60,000 loan against $100,000 worth of Bitcoin, your initial LTV is 60%.
If Bitcoin's price falls by 25%, your LTV jumps to 80%.

itens.titulo: Tesla Stock Jumps as Shanghai Deliveries Rise for 11th Straight Month
itens.descricao: Tesla Stock Jumps as Shanghai Deliveries Rise for 11th Straight Month Yahoo Finance
trechos: Tesla (TSLA) shares climbed 3% in morning trading Friday after fresh data showed higher sales of electric vehicles manufactured in China, while demand in Europe continued to recover.

The company delivered 95,366 Model 3 and Model Y vehicles produced at its Shanghai factory in September, a 5% increase from 90,812 units a year earlier, according to China Passenger Car Association data released Friday.
The latest increase extended the annual growth streak to 11 months.
GuruFocus has detected 6 Warning Signs with TSLA.
Shanghai-built vehicle sales also advanced 13.7% year over year in the third quarter.
However, Tesla's worldwide deliveries fell 2.1% from the same period last year, when the automaker recorded a quarterly delivery record.
Selected Model Y versions qualify for a 7,000-yuan discount on final payments, while Model 3 buyers can receive 5,000 yuan off.

itens.titulo: Marvell (MRVL) Is Aiming for $90B in Sales. Why Does It Trade Under 24 Times Earnings?
itens.descricao: Marvell (MRVL) Is Aiming for $90B in Sales. Why Does It Trade Under 24 Times Earnings? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Management targets $70 billion to $90 billion in revenue by fiscal 2031, up from a fiscal 2026 base of $8.2 billion.
And yet the stock trades at 23.81 times expected earnings, below both its own history and its sector.

It also calls itself the market leader in coherent pluggable optics (the modules that link data centers over long distances), supplying the top five hyperscalers and shipping more than 1 million units.
In fiscal Q2 2027, total revenue rose 37% year over year to $2.74 billion, while data center sales jumped 46% to $2.17 billion.
Data center now makes up 79% of the business, up from 76% the quarter before and 74% a year earlier.
Management credited broad demand, including strong connectivity orders, and guided for about $3.15 billion in fiscal Q3 revenue.
Marvell raised its fiscal 2028 revenue outlook to $20 billion, roughly $18 billion of it from data centers.
It also lifted its fiscal 2029 custom revenue target to more than $12 billion, from $10 billion, a figure it expects to be more than triple the fiscal 2028 level.
